podcast.title: Older Than Punk Contemporaries
podcast.body: This punk-era band, which emerged in 1977, had members who were older than most of their contemporaries at the time of their debut. "The motors, another punk era band, were also older than most when they first showed up in 1977."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Age at Debut (36)
xref.body: When The Motors released their first album in 1977, Andy McMaster was 36 years old, making him older than many other artists in the punk scene. "Andy McMaster from the band was a stately 36 when they released their first album."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
